title: malaxis distans
intro: Malaxis distans, commonly known as the 'broad-leaved orchid', is a type of flowering plant species that belongs to the orchid family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Malaxis distans are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents of Malaxis distans and its potential therapeutic applications.
